# WebAuthn positive vectors

Captured 2026-11-10T10:08:18.826Z with Chromium 148.0.7778.96 and Playwright 1.64.0-alpha-1790635538000.

A disposable localhost HTTP page uses native create/get and toJSON(), with separate ES256 and RS256 ceremonies. CDP WebAuthn.addVirtualAuthenticator enables CTAP2, resident keys, user verification, isUserVerified, and automatic presence. Each JSON records its exact origin, RP ID, challenges and user handle. The ES256 counterAssertions each have signCount 6 and different challenges; the virtual credential was reset to count 5 through CDP between them. No private key is saved. Negative SPKI keys (P-384, RSA-1024 and a different P-256 key) are generated by Node crypto only for refusal tests. These are test credentials only.
